title: #153 Experience v.s. Degree
prompt: University experience is more important than a university’s degree. Some people argue that university life is much more important than an educational degree in job market. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: University experience is more important than a university’s degree.
Some people argue that university life is much more important than an educational degree in job market.
